submission.justification: Sensor-T1 at 150 um gave the best unirradiated single-hit resolution in the simulation (5.984 um). Across thicknesses, T1 stayed between about 6.0 and 6.7 um for 50-200 um, and it degraded to 7.84 um at 300 um, so 150 um is a sound choice. T3 (best 8.76 um at 150 um) and T2 (best 14.4 um at 100 um) were clearly worse. The recommendation is provisional. The project documents contain no radiation-damage data, and no irradiated resolution was simulated (radiation_data_in_documents = 0, irradiated_resolution_simulated = 0). The brief requires suitability for the innermost-layer radiation environment (about 1.5 GHz/cm2 hit rate, -35 C), and that cannot be confirmed from the available results. Before this choice is adopted, T1 at 150 um needs irradiated characterisation (charge collection and resolution after the expected HL-LHC fluence). If T1 fails that check, the choice should be revisited, since the other two technologies are worse on resolution in the unirradiated case.
